rows.grounds: optative of pūj with enclitic ca; fused form kept as one token
compound denoting the realm of Śiva

items.question: What reward follows from performing worship on the fourteenth lunar day?
premises: Worship should be performed on the fourteenth lunar day.
Ritual worship produces a post-ritual consequence for the worshipper.
The stated consequence is honor in the world of Śiva.
items.inference: Therefore, worship on the fourteenth lunar day results in being honored in Śiva's world.
items.plain_english: And one should worship on the fourteenth day; thereby one is honored in the world of Śiva.
